thread.title: Free speech debate among Big Tech - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: Yoel Minkoff
title: Free speech debate among Big Tech - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
All but one of the major content platforms have banned the accounts of Alex Jones as tech giants raced to act in the wake of Apple's (NASDAQ: AAPL ) decision to remove podcasts by his Infowars website.
While Facebook (NASDAQ: FB ), YouTube ( GOOG , GOOGL ) and Spotify (NYSE: SPOT ) said his content violated community guidelines, such as those prohibiting hate speech and harassment, Twitter (NYSE: TWTR ) is leaving his handles open, but will "take action if it needs to."
Previously: Apple drops Infowars from podcast directory (Aug. 06 2018)
